jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.content: <p>Massive Dynamic's applied ML team ships models and LLM features into our research products. This is a remote role open to candidates anywhere in Canada.</p><h3>Responsibilities</h3><ul><li>Train, evaluate and deploy PyTorch models</li><li>Build LLM application features with retrieval and structured outputs</li><li>Track experiments and model versions with MLflow</li></ul><h3>Requirements</h3><ul><li>0-2 years of industry experience; new graduates welcome</li><li>Proficiency in Python and PyTorch</li><li>Experience training and evaluating machine learning models</li><li>Experience building LLM applications</li><li>Experience with MLflow or a similar experiment tracker</li><li>Kubernetes is an asset</li></ul><p>Remote within Canada. We are an equal opportunity employer. This company is fictional and exists only in the Prospect demo.</p>

jobs.title: Software Engineer II
jobs.content: <p>Build the core services behind Massive Dynamic's lab-automation platform.</p><h3>Requirements</h3><ul><li>5+ years of professional software development experience</li><li>Strong Python or Java</li><li>Experience designing REST APIs and relational schemas</li></ul><p>Hybrid in Toronto, 3 days a week. We are an equal opportunity employer. This company is fictional and exists only in the Prospect demo.</p>
